description: Source code for NetworkManagerStunClient, implementing STUN protocol client functionalities including message encoding/decoding, socket communication, and network address handling.

classes.name: file_descriptor
classes.description: Manages a file descriptor, ensuring proper closure upon destruction.

methods.name: create_binding_request
methods.description: Creates a STUN binding request message with a random transaction ID and change request attribute.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Performs a STUN binding to discover public IP, with caching and retries.

methods.name: create_udp_socket
methods.description: Creates and binds a UDP socket, optionally to a specified local interface.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Sends a STUN message over UDP and waits for a response within a timeout.

methods.name: discover_network_access_type
methods.description: Discovers network access type (e.g., UDP blocked, unknown) using STUN binding.

methods.name: send_binding_request

methods.description: Constructs an address object from a STUN attribute.
